content:
Sam: heads-up: ops asked why SLO alerts were invisible during yesterday's canary. Console shows "suppressed" only. Can we design a small explainability surface?
Ellen: absolute yes. Minimal UI: one-line reason + 'view decision' link. Example: "suppressed 7% sampled7 quiet-window(team-non-prod)"
Ravi: API needs to return a compact decision artifact. Keep it <512B: decision_id, event_id, matched_rules[], sample_pct, seed, policy_version, result. TTL ~14 days.
Marta: Console: badge in the SLO activity stream, hover shows matched rules and sample_pct. Clicking opens a side panel with policy refs + timestamp. Add a "force notify" button for admins with audit log.
Sam: security: `force notify` must check scope `slo.force` and write audit entry (actor, time, reason).
Ellen: telemetry: emit `slo.decision.recorded` with fields so downstream can show effective notify-rate timeseries.
Ravi: implementation note: signer (HMAC) on decision records so cached UI can't be tampered with. Store only refs to policies, not full blobs.
Marta: rollout plan: behind ff for internal orgs, enable after 1 week of telemetry validation.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: slo-decision-writer v1 -> canary-4. Monitor `slo.decision.recorded` counts and errors.
Sam: actionables: (1) infra proto + HMAC + TTL (Ravi) (2) telemetry event (Ellen) (3) Console badge/panel + force-notify flow (Marta) (4) security review (Sam). Sync in 45m. :thumbsup:
